workItem: Extend the canonical GitHub settings inventory into one read-only management adapter with explicit Enterprise, Organization, Repository and User scopes and machine-readable coverage gaps.
workItemDE: Das kanonische GitHub-Settings-Inventar zu einem read-only Management-Adapter mit expliziten Enterprise-, Organization-, Repository- und User-Scopes sowie maschinenlesbaren Coverage-Lücken erweitern.
priorityReason: Fresh Human Owner direction requires a scope-complete readback surface before settings are reviewed one-by-one in chat.
scopeBoundary: Read-only inventory only; no GitHub provider settings mutation.
Enterprise, Organization, Repository and User remain distinct authorization scopes.
Existing Enterprise PAT and GitHub App installation clients are reused; no second settings authority is created.
User scope may use a dedicated read token when configured, otherwise the existing Enterprise PAT is reused only for whatever authenticated-user reads its scopes permit.
Every unsupported or insufficiently authorized capability is surfaced as NOT_OBSERVABLE with its required permission; coverage gaps are never treated as defaults.
Secrets, PATs, private keys, raw key material, raw email addresses and reviewer identities are never exported.
exitEvidence: Composite adapter exposes four scopes and cannot route a capability to the wrong scope.
Existing Enterprise/Organization/Repository settings remain backward-compatible in the flat entries projection.
User account inventory redacts email addresses and cryptographic key material.
Additional runner/security/custom-property settings are bounded GET-only capabilities.
Output reports per-scope PASS/PARTIAL_COVERAGE plus explicit notObservable capabilities.
Targeted tests prove scope routing and redaction.
Exact-head CI/Security/Governance checks pass; Human/CODEOWNER merge remains required.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
